legacy.name: mentors
legacy.sql:
CREATE TABLE mentors (
                id          INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
                discord_id  TEXT    NOT NULL UNIQUE,
                name        TEXT    NOT NULL,
                bio         TEXT    DEFAULT '',
                is_active   INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1
            )

legacy.name: slots
legacy.sql:
CREATE TABLE slots (
                id          INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
                mentor_id   INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES mentors(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
                start_time  TEXT    NOT NULL,
                end_time    TEXT    NOT NULL,
                label       TEXT    NOT NULL,
                is_active   INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1
            )

legacy.name: bookings
legacy.sql:
CREATE TABLE bookings (
                id          INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
                slot_id     INTEGER NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES slots(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
                user_id     TEXT    NOT NULL,
                user_name   TEXT    NOT NULL,
                booked_at   TEXT    NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now'))
            , status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'approved', rejection_reason TEXT DEFAULT '')

legacy.name: panels
legacy.sql:
CREATE TABLE panels (
                id          INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
                channel_id  TEXT    NOT NULL,
                message_id  TEXT    NOT NULL,
                guild_id    TEXT    NOT NULL
            )

legacy.name: slot_templates
legacy.sql:
CREATE TABLE slot_templates (
                id               INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
                mentor_id        INTEGER NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES mentors(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
                start_hour       INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 19,
                start_minute     INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
                end_hour         INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 21,
                end_minute       INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
                interval_minutes INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 30
            )

legacy.name: blocked_dates
legacy.sql:
CREATE TABLE blocked_dates (
                id        INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
                mentor_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES mentors(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
                date      TEXT    NOT NULL,
                UNIQUE(mentor_id, date)
            )

legacy.name: reminders
legacy.sql:
CREATE TABLE reminders (
                id         INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
                booking_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES bookings(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
                type       TEXT    NOT NULL,
                sent_at    TEXT    NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now')),
                UNIQUE(booking_id, type)
            )

legacy.name: qa_alerts
legacy.sql:
CREATE TABLE qa_alerts (
                thread_id  TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
                alerted_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now'))
            )

legacy.name: blocked_weekdays
legacy.sql:
CREATE TABLE blocked_weekdays (
                id        INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
                mentor_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES mentors(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
                weekday   INTEGER NOT NULL,  -- 0=월 1=화 2=수 3=목 4=금 5=토 6=일
                UNIQUE(mentor_id, weekday)
            )

legacy.name: onboarding_progress
legacy.sql:
CREATE TABLE onboarding_progress (
                user_id      TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
                guild_id     TEXT NOT NULL,
                joined_at    TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now')),
                intro_done   INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
                completed_at TEXT
            )

legacy.name: assignments
legacy.sql:
CREATE TABLE assignments (
                id          INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
                week        INTEGER NOT NULL,
                title       TEXT    NOT NULL,
                description TEXT    NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
                due_date    TEXT    NOT NULL,
                type        TEXT    NOT NULL DEFAULT 'team',
                created_at  TEXT    NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now')),
                is_active   INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1
            , fields TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '["제출 내용"]')

legacy.name: submissions
legacy.sql:
CREATE TABLE submissions (
                id            INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
                assignment_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES assignments(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
                user_id       TEXT    NOT NULL,
                user_name     TEXT    NOT NULL,
                team          TEXT    NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
                content       TEXT    NOT NULL,
                link          TEXT    NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
                submitted_at  TEXT    NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now')),
                UNIQUE(assignment_id, user_id)
            )

legacy.name: assignment_panels

CREATE TABLE assignment_panels (

                channel_id  TEXT NOT NULL,

            )

legacy.name: assignment_reminders
legacy.sql:
CREATE TABLE assignment_reminders (
                assignment_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
                team          TEXT    NOT NULL,
                sent_at       TEXT    NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now')),
                UNIQUE(assignment_id, team)
            )

legacy.name: peer_eval_rounds
legacy.sql:
CREATE TABLE peer_eval_rounds (
                id          INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
                title       TEXT    NOT NULL,
                created_at  TEXT    NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now')),
                is_active   INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1
            )

legacy.name: peer_evaluations
legacy.sql:
CREATE TABLE peer_evaluations (
                id            INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
                round_id      INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES peer_eval_rounds(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
                team          TEXT    NOT NULL,
                evaluator_id  TEXT    NOT NULL,
                target_id     TEXT    NOT NULL,
                target_name   TEXT    NOT NULL,
                score1        INTEGER NOT NULL,  -- ① 과업 완수(산출물)
                score2        INTEGER NOT NULL,  -- ② 협업·소통
                score3        INTEGER NOT NULL,  -- ③ 책임·약속 이행
                score4        INTEGER NOT NULL,  -- ④ 팀 기여·문제해결
                comment       TEXT    NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
                submitted_at  TEXT    NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now')),
                UNIQUE(round_id, evaluator_id, target_id)
            )
